# Baseline selection

Selected source: **Iteration 005 / 5.2 / M / Run-02**.

Run-02 is selected because it is the stronger compliant M implementation after independent comparison. Run-01 remains useful as evidence of alternative implementation choices but contains known scope/fidelity/Windows-input defects already repaired in Run-02.

`baseline/` is immutable evidence. Refinement must never edit it in place.
